tmdb_overview: In a cotton-farming village in Sudan, teenage Nafisa is raised on heroic tales of battling British colonizers told by her grandmother, the village matriarch Al-Sit. Awakening to her own strength, Nafisa sets out to save the cotton fields – and herself. Neither she nor her community will ever be the same again.

The death of his son causes McElwee, an autobiographical filmmaker, to look back on his life’s work. He eventually turns to his archive of home movies. To what extent did his camera affect their relationship when Adrian was alive? To what extent does it define that relationship now that he is gone? Meanwhile, an effort to adapt McElwee’s first feature, Sherman’s March, into a work of fiction lurches along, giving the filmmaker another perspective from which to meditate on movie making and mortality.

Documentarian Ross McElwee originally set out to make a travelogue of sorts tracing General William T. Sherman's infamous scorched-earth march through the Confederacy in the latter stages of the Civil War. Instead, haunted by a recent breakup with a girlfriend, McElwee ends up documenting his progress -- or lack thereof -- in starting a new relationship. His journey then becomes one of self-reflection and self-discovery rather than a historical/sociological exploration.

tmdb_overview: When their plan to book a show at the Rivoli goes horribly wrong, Matt and Jay accidentally travel back to the year 2008.
A filmmaker recalls his childhood, when he fell in love with the movies at his village's theater and formed a deep friendship with the theater's projectionist.

In the post-apocalyptic future, reigning tyrannical supercomputers teleport a cyborg assassin known as the "Terminator" back to 1984 to kill Sarah Connor, whose unborn son is destined to lead insurgents against 21st century mechanical hegemony. Meanwhile, the human-resistance movement dispatches a lone warrior to safeguard Sarah. Can he stop the virtually indestructible killing machine?

movie_title: Have A Gd Trip presents Yeah Right!
movie_title_en: Have A Gd Trip presents Yeah Right!

tmdb_overview: Ten years after the events of the original, a reprogrammed T-800 is sent back in time to protect young John Connor from the shape-shifting T-1000. Together with his mother Sarah, he fights to stop Skynet from triggering a nuclear apocalypse.
The adventures of a group of explorers who make use of a newly discovered wormhole to surpass the limitations on human space travel and conquer the vast distances involved in an interstellar voyage.

Keong comes from Hong Kong to visit New York for his uncle's wedding. His uncle runs a market in the Bronx and Keong offers to help out while Uncle is on his honeymoon. During his stay in the Bronx, Keong befriends a neighbor kid and beats up some neighborhood thugs who cause problems at the market. One of those petty thugs in the local gang stumbles into a criminal situation way over his head.
A secret military project endangers Neo-Tokyo when it turns a biker gang member into a rampaging psychic psychopath that only two teenagers and a group of psychics can stop.

Driver is a skilled Hollywood stuntman who moonlights as a getaway driver for criminals. Though he projects an icy exterior, lately he's been warming up to a pretty neighbor named Irene and her young son, Benicio. When Irene's husband gets out of jail, he enlists Driver's help in a million-dollar heist. The job goes horribly wrong, and Driver must risk his life to protect Irene and Benicio from the vengeful masterminds behind the robbery.

Taking a break from their dreary lives, close friends Thelma and Louise embark on a short weekend trip that ends in unforeseen incriminating circumstances. As fugitives, both women rediscover the strength of their bond and their newfound resilience.
A private eye investigates the apparent suicide of a fading porn star in 1970s Los Angeles and uncovers a conspiracy.

At a tiny Parisian café, the adorable yet painfully shy Amélie accidentally discovers a gift for helping others. Soon Amelie is spending her days as a matchmaker, guardian angel, and all-around do-gooder. But when she bumps into a handsome stranger, will she find the courage to become the star of her very own love story?
The Autobots must stop a colossal planet-consuming robot who goes after the Autobot Matrix of Leadership. At the same time, they must defend themselves against an all-out attack from the Decepticons.
A group of male friends become obsessed with five mysterious sisters who are sheltered by their strict, religious parents.

The life of the revered 18th-century Armenian poet and musician Sayat-Nova. Portraying events in the life of the artist from childhood up to his death, the movie addresses in particular his relationships with women, including his muse. The production tells Sayat-Nova's dramatic story by using both his poems and largely still camerawork, creating a work hailed as revolutionary by Mikhail Vartanov.

The true story of Henry Hill, a half-Irish, half-Sicilian Brooklyn kid who is adopted by neighbourhood gangsters at an early age and climbs the ranks of a Mafia family under the guidance of Jimmy Conway.

A concert film documenting Talking Heads at the height of their popularity, on tour for their 1983 album "Speaking in Tongues." The band takes the stage one by one and is joined by a cadre of guest musicians for a career-spanning and cinematic performance that features creative choreography and visuals.
Alexander, a journalist, philosopher and retired actor, celebrates a birthday with friends and family when it is announced that nuclear war has begun.
A young witch, on her mandatory year of independent life, finds fitting into a new community difficult while she supports herself by running an air courier service.

In the deep south during the 1930s, three escaped convicts search for hidden treasure while a relentless lawman pursues them.

Clarice Starling is a top student at the FBI's training academy.  Jack Crawford wants Clarice to interview Dr. Hannibal Lecter, a brilliant psychiatrist who is also a violent psychopath, serving life behind bars for various acts of murder and cannibalism.  Crawford believes that Lecter may have insight into a case and that Starling, as an attractive young woman, may be just the bait to draw him out.

A sorcerer and his apprentice are on a mission to kill an evil dragon to save the King’s daughter from being sacrificed according to a pact that the King himself made with the dragon to protect his kingdom.

tmdb_overview: A former assassin—known only as The Bride—wakes up from a coma after her former boss and lover, Bill, shoots her in the head and steals her unborn child during her wedding rehearsal. She soon embarks on a bloody quest for revenge, hunting down her ex-colleagues of the Deadly Viper Assassination Squad before confronting Bill himself. Quentin Tarantino’s complete Kill Bill, a combination of Volumes 1 and 2, previously deleted scenes, alternate takes, a full-color remaster of the Crazy 88 fight, a 7-minute anime sequence by Production I.G., and a built-in intermission.

tmdb_overview: As armies mass for a final battle that will decide the fate of the world--and powerful, ancient forces of Light and Dark compete to determine the outcome--one member of the Fellowship of the Ring is revealed as the noble heir to the throne of the Kings of Men. Yet, the sole hope for triumph over evil lies with a brave hobbit, Frodo, who, accompanied by his loyal friend Sam and the hideous, wretched Gollum, ventures deep into the very dark heart of Mordor on his seemingly impossible quest to destroy the Ring of Power.​

Joe Gideon is at the top of the heap, one of the most successful directors and choreographers in musical theater. But he can feel his world slowly collapsing around him - his obsession with work has almost destroyed his personal life, and only his bottles of pills keep him going.
Two melancholic Hong Kong policemen fall in love: one with a mysterious underworld figure, the other with a beautiful and ethereal server at a late-night restaurant.
An assassin goes through obstacles as he attempts to escape his violent lifestyle despite the opposition of his partner, who is secretly attracted to him.
A graduate student and obsessive runner in New York is drawn into a mysterious plot involving his brother, a member of the secretive Division.

tmdb_overview: Small-time pimp Franz is torn between his mistress and Bruno, the gangster sent after him by a shady crime syndicate he has refused to join.
The adventures of a group of explorers who make use of a newly discovered wormhole to surpass the limitations on human space travel and conquer the vast distances involved in an interstellar voyage.

Documentary filmmaker Genya Tachibana has tracked down the legendary actress Chiyoko Fujiwara, who mysteriously vanished at the height of her career. When he presents her with a key she had lost and thought was gone forever, the filmmaker could not have imagined that it would not only unlock the long-held secrets of Chiyoko’s life... but also his own.

Five friends head out to rural Texas to visit the grave of a grandfather. On the way, they stumble across what appears to be a deserted house, only to discover something sinister within. Something armed with a chainsaw.

The Director's Cut of Kingdom of Heaven is widely considered by critics and film enthusiasts to be a masterpiece that completely transforms and saves the original movie. Directed by Ridley Scott and released in late 2005, this version adds 45 to 50 minutes of crucial footage, removed due to fears of large runtime, back into the film, extending the runtime to 3 hours and 14 minutes. The original 144-minute theatrical release suffered from heavy studio editing, leaving gaping plot holes and shallow character motivations.

Spanning the years 1945 to 1955, a chronicle of the fictional Italian-American Corleone crime family. When organized crime family patriarch, Vito Corleone barely survives an attempt on his life, his youngest son, Michael steps in to take care of the would-be killers, launching a campaign of bloody revenge.

Clarice Starling is a top student at the FBI's training academy.  Jack Crawford wants Clarice to interview Dr. Hannibal Lecter, a brilliant psychiatrist who is also a violent psychopath, serving life behind bars for various acts of murder and cannibalism.  Crawford believes that Lecter may have insight into a case and that Starling, as an attractive young woman, may be just the bait to draw him out.

It took Anna 10 years to recover from the death of her husband, Sean, but now she's on the verge of marrying her boyfriend, Joseph, and finally moving on. However, on the night of her engagement party, a young boy named Sean turns up, saying he is her dead husband reincarnated. At first she ignores the child, but his knowledge of her former husband's life is uncanny, leading her to believe that he might be telling the truth.

Jack Torrance accepts a caretaker job at the Overlook Hotel, where he, along with his wife Wendy and their son Danny, must live isolated from the rest of the world for the winter. But they aren't prepared for the madness that lurks within.
In October of 1994 three student filmmakers disappeared in the woods near Burkittsville, Maryland, while shooting a documentary. A year later their footage was found.
A Taipei family faces personal and moral uncertainty as everyday events test their relationships and sense of purpose.
The mysterious Count Orlok summons a happily married real estate agent to his castle, located up in the Transylvanian mountains, to finalise a terrifying deal.

Five friends head out to rural Texas to visit the grave of a grandfather. On the way, they stumble across what appears to be a deserted house, only to discover something sinister within. Something armed with a chainsaw.

Blonde Betty Elms has only just arrived in Hollywood to become a movie star when she meets an enigmatic brunette with amnesia. Meanwhile, as the two set off to solve the second woman's identity, filmmaker Adam Kesher runs into ominous trouble while casting his latest project.
Years after a terrible boating accident, Angela is sent to Camp Arawak where a series of bizarre and violent "accidents" begin to claim the lives of various campers.

In this humorous paean to the joys of food, a pair of truck drivers happen onto a decrepit roadside shop selling ramen noodles. The widowed owner, Tampopo, begs them to help her turn her establishment into a paragon of the "art of noodle-soup making". Interspersed are satirical vignettes about the importance of food to different aspects of human life.

A wealthy entrepreneur secretly creates a theme park featuring living dinosaurs drawn from prehistoric DNA. Before opening day, he invites a team of experts and his two eager grandchildren to experience the park and help calm anxious investors. However, the park is anything but amusing as the security systems go off-line and the dinosaurs escape.
When an unsuspecting town newcomer is drawn to local blood fiends, the Frog brothers and other unlikely heroes gear up to rescue him.

In 2047, a group of astronauts are sent to investigate and salvage the starship Event Horizon which disappeared mysteriously seven years before on its maiden voyage. However, it soon becomes evident that something sinister resides in its corridors.
Fifteen years after murdering his sister on Halloween Night 1963, Michael Myers escapes from a mental hospital and returns to the small town of Haddonfield, Illinois to kill again.

An insurance investigator visits a small town while looking into the strange disappearance of a popular horror novelist. He soon finds that the impact of the author’s books is far more than inspirational.

Ruthless silver miner, turned oil prospector, Daniel Plainview, moves to oil-rich California. Using his son to project a trustworthy, family-man image, Plainview cons local landowners into selling him their valuable properties for a pittance. However, local preacher Eli Sunday suspects Plainview's motives and intentions, starting a slow-burning feud that threatens both their lives.

A young neurosurgeon inherits the castle of his grandfather, the famous Dr. Victor von Frankenstein. In the castle he finds a funny hunchback, a pretty lab assistant and the elderly housekeeper. Young Frankenstein believes that the work of his grandfather was delusional, but when he discovers the book where the mad doctor described his reanimation experiment, he suddenly changes his mind.

Rising pop star Mima quits singing to pursue a career as an actress. After she takes up a role on a popular detective show, her handlers and collaborators begin turning up murdered. Harboring feelings of guilt and haunted by visions of her former self, Mima's reality and fantasy meld into a frenzied paranoia.
An Irish rogue uses his cunning and wit to work his way up the social classes of 18th century England, transforming himself from the humble Redmond Barry into the noble Barry Lyndon.
An American newcomer to a prestigious German ballet academy comes to realize that the school is a front for something sinister amid a series of grisly murders.

tmdb_overview: Teenagers in a small town are dropping like flies, apparently in the grip of mass hysteria causing their suicides. A cop's daughter, Nancy Thompson, traces the cause to child molester Fred Krueger, who was burned alive by angry parents many years before. Krueger has now come back in the dreams of his killers' children, claiming their lives as his revenge. Nancy and her boyfriend, Glen, must devise a plan to lure the monster out of the realm of nightmares and into the real world...

Jack Torrance accepts a caretaker job at the Overlook Hotel, where he, along with his wife Wendy and their son Danny, must live isolated from the rest of the world for the winter. But they aren't prepared for the madness that lurks within.

In a contemporary New York City, members of a dysfunctional family of vampires are trying to come to terms with each other, in the wake of their father's death. Meanwhile, they are being hunted by Dr. Van Helsing and his hapless nephew. As in all good vampire movies, forces of love are pitted against forces of destruction.

When New York is caught in the grip of a sadistic serial killer who preys on patrons of the city's underground bars, young rookie Steve Burns infiltrates the S&M subculture to try and lure him out of the shadows.
After a bizarre and near fatal encounter with a serial killer, a newswoman is sent to a rehabilitation center whose inhabitants may not be what they seem.
A young schoolteacher descends into personal moral degradation after finding himself stranded in a brutal, menacing town in outback Australia.

Ten years after the events of the original, a reprogrammed T-800 is sent back in time to protect young John Connor from the shape-shifting T-1000. Together with his mother Sarah, he fights to stop Skynet from triggering a nuclear apocalypse.
A research team in Antarctica is hunted by a shape-shifting alien that assumes the appearance of its victims.
When a shy teenager's new-found powers help him score at basketball - and with the popular girls - he has some pretty hairy decisions to make.

American tourists David and Jack are savagely attacked by an unidentified animal while hiking on the Yorkshire Moors. After retiring to the home of a beautiful nurse to recuperate, David soon begins experiencing disturbing changes to his body and mind.
Trying to leave their troubled lives behind, twin brothers return to their hometown to start again, only to discover that an even greater evil is waiting to welcome them back.

A hedonistic man finds a mysterious puzzle box that summons a group of gruesome beings known as the Cenobites. These otherworldly entities open the doors to a dominion where pain and pleasure are indivisible.

After breaking the mysterious "One Wish Willow" to win his crush's heart, a hopeless romantic finds himself getting exactly what he asked for but soon discovers that some desires come at a dark, sinister price.

A woman’s lover and her ex-boyfriend take justice into their own hands after she becomes the victim of a rapist. Because some acts can’t be undone. Because man is an animal. Because the desire for vengeance is a natural impulse. Because most crimes remain unpunished.

Johnny is a successful banker with great respect for and dedication to the people in his life, especially his future wife Lisa. The happy-go-lucky guy sees his world being torn apart when his friends begin to betray him one-by-one.

Amanda and her stepfather Martin struggle with a moral issue that divides them. Has Amanda’s mother Leslie, who has dementia, lost the ability to make critical decisions in her own best interests? And, if so, who is responsible – a spouse, a child, an institution – for making such a determination? As Amanda and Martin are forced to make increasingly difficult choices, the repercussions spiral out of their control. Academy Award winner Juliette Binoche (The Taste of Things), Academy Award nominee Tom Courtenay (45 Years), Anna Calder-Marshall (Wuthering Heights), and Florence Hunt (Bridgerton) star in this unflinching drama. The film won the Silver Bear Jury Prize and Tom Courtenay and Anna Calder-Marshall won the Silver Bear for Best Supporting Performance at the 2026 Berlin International Film Festival.

movie_title: The Last Responders + Blow Out (18) with an introduction by Caline Matar
movie_title_en: The Last Responders + Blow Out (18) with an introduction by Caline Matar
tmdb_overview: On 23 March 2025 in Tel al-Sultan, Gaza, Israeli forces massacred fifteen Palestinian aid workers travelling in clearly marked humanitarian vehicles, later burying their bodies and vehicles in a shallow mass grave. Earshot and Forensic Architecture worked with the Palestine Red Crescent Society and survivors of the massacre to reconstruct the incident with unprecedented precision.  The Last Responders is an investigative documentary about this massacre. Anchored in the situated testimonies of two survivors, the film draws on firsthand video and voice recordings captured during the night of the attack by the Palestine Red Crescent Society. Through these materials, the film probes acts of execution and concealment, while reconstructing a fuller account of what unfolded in Tel al-Sultan in the hours and days that followed.

A residency at New York’s Village Vanguard culminates in the live taping of two of the greatest jazz records of all time in one night. Ten days later, LaFaro dies in a car crash. Numb with grief, Evans stops playing.

synopsis:
Bad Apples 
Genre(s): Comedy/ThrillerUSA/UK | 2025| 100 minsDirector: Jonathan EtzlerStars: Jacob Anderson, Saoirse Ronan, Robert EmmsOur Tuesday 7:30pm screening contains descriptive subtitles for those with hearing loss.A blackly comic British thriller,
adapted from the Swedish novel De Oönskare (The Unwanted), and starring
Saoirse Ronan as struggling primary school teacher Maria. After a behavioural
incident on a school trip, she makes an escalating series of bad choices.
Surprised however by the knock-on effects of these decisions, the audience is
ultimately left to decide the fallout from Maria's extreme approach to
classroom management. Featuring some incredibly realistic classroom scenes and
fantastic performances from Oscar nominee Ronan and her students played by
Eddie Waller and Nia Brown, this 2025 festival favourite is a must watch this
term.

Christmas. This witty and bittersweet comedy-drama intertwines the
stories of Raúl and Elsa: Raúl is a filmmaker, writing his next screenplay;

the stories we steal to tell our own.

synopsis:
Cotton Queen 
Genre(s): DramaSUD/GER/FRA/PAL/EGY/QAT/SAU | 2025 | 93 Mins (Arabic with English Subtitles)Director: Suzannah MirghaniStars: Mihad Murtada, Rabha Mohamed Mahmoud, Talaat
Fareed
Mirghani’s
debut feature, a mixture of coming-of-age drama and post-colonial critique,
focusses on teenager Nafisa. Having grown up with her grandmother’s tales of
outsmarting the British, she works in the cotton fields of Sudan with her
friends. She is friendly with a local lad, but her mother has her sights set on
her marriage to Nadir, a British businessman eager to sell his genetically
modified cotton seed to the local farmers. Old practices such as FGM come
face-to-face with the modern world of corporate business and mobile phones in
this beautifully shot, arresting film.
Black History Month screening in conjunction with Croydon
Black History Partnership.
tmdb_overview: In a cotton-farming village in Sudan, teenage Nafisa is raised on heroic tales of battling British colonizers told by her grandmother, the village matriarch Al-Sit. But when a young businessman arrives from abroad with a new development plan and genetically engineered cotton, Nafisa becomes the center of a power play to determine the future of the village. Awakening to her own strength, Nafisa sets out to save the cotton fields – and herself. Neither she nor her community will ever be the same again.

Genre(s): Animation/Comedy/AdventureUSA | 2026 | 101 minsDirector: Dave GreenStars: Will Forte, Lana Condor, John CenaThis film contains flashing images which may affect viewers who are susceptible to photosensitive epilepsy.When loyal Acme
Corporation customer (and avowed enemy of Road Runner) Wile E. Coyote has
finally had enough of the company’s faulty goods, he’s left with one last
course of action: a lawsuit. Securing the services of ambulance-chasing
attorney Kevin Avery (Will Forte), the pair have to take on Acme’s hotshot
lawyer Buddy Crane (John Cena), who happens to be Avery’s former boss. Three
years after being shelved as a tax write-off by its studio, this madcap mix of
animation and live-action is seeing the light of day at long last, presenting
the world of Looney Tunes as you’ve never seen it before.

synopsis:
Dracula (Cert TBC) & Short film
Genre: HorrorUK | 1958 | 83 minsDirector: Terence Fisher
Stars: Peter Cushing, Christopher Lee, Michael Gough

A landmark in English Gothic horror, Dracula made
Christopher Lee an international star, and caused major American distributors
to compete to release Hammer’s films. Elegant but shocking, this first colour
adaptation of Bram Stoker’s novel offered Lee’s physicality and seductive
menace, opposite Peter Cushing’s fearless Van Helsing. Now, following the
discovery of film elements in a Warner Bros. warehouse, a brand new restoration
brings the original uncut version (previously only seen in Japan in 1958) to UK
cinemas for the first time! Halloween screening, with support from Croydon
Council.
Plus
a short (10 mins) exploring the film’s restoration.

tmdb_overview: In late 15th-century Eastern Europe, Prince Vlad II’s bride is brutally murdered. As a result, he renounces God and damns Heaven itself. Cursed with eternal life, Vlad is reborn as Dracula, an immortal warlord who defies fate in a blood-soaked crusade to wrench his lost love back from death.

movie_title_en: ENGLISH NATIONAL BALLET PRESENTS THE SLEEPING BEAUTY
synopsis:
English Nation Ballet Presents Sleeping Beauty 
Genre: PerformanceUK | 2026 | 160 minsDirectors: Ross MacGibbon, Kenneth MacMillan
This classic fairytale ballet with a famous Tchaikovsky
score, is choreographed by Sir Kenneth MacMillan and filmed from a limited run
at The Royal Albert Hall. As a baby, Princess Aurora is cursed by the wicked
Carabosse: on her 16th birthday, she will prick her finger and die. Her
godmother the Lilac Fairy alters the spell so Aurora will not die, but sleep
for 100 years. Only a true love’s kiss can break the spell and awaken her. An
exquisite version of one of the world’s favourite stories. 
Tickets £15.
tmdb_title: English National Ballet presents The Sleeping Beauty
tmdb_original_title: English National Ballet presents The Sleeping Beauty
tmdb_overview: A spellbinding fairytale ballet filmed at London’s Royal Albert Hall.  Sir Kenneth MacMillan’s exquisite ballet will leave you spellbound. A stunning version of one of the world’s favourite fairytales, filmed at London’s Royal Albert Hall.  Featuring First Soloist Anna Nevzorova as Aurora and Davi Ramos as Prince Désiré, the film will whisk you away to an enchanted land and a story of good versus evil. As a baby, Princess Aurora is cursed by the wicked Carabosse (Eireen Evrard). Her godmother, the Lilac Fairy (Anri Sugiura), alters the spell so Aurora will not die, but sleep for 100 years. Only a true love’s kiss can awaken her.  From Aurora’s christening in the palace, to her jubilant wedding, the bewitching tale is brought to life before your eyes through beautiful choreography, sumptuous costumes and stunning new projection sets by Charlotte MacMillan.

synopsis:
Late Fame 
Genre(s): Comedy/DramaUSA | 2025| 96 minsDirector: Kent JonesStars: Jake Lacy, Willem Dafoe, Greta Lee, Graham Campbell, Clark Johnson
Ed Saxberger (Willem Dafoe) is a
quiet New York post office worker who wrote a well-regarded book of poetry in
the late 1970s, before disappearing into obscurity. Decades later, a young
admirer (Edmund Donovan) tracks him down and introduces him to the “Enthusiasm
Society”, a group of privileged twenty-somethings who see Saxberger
as an overlooked literary genius from a bygone era of New York.

Flattered by their attention,
Saxberger is drawn back into the artistic world he left behind and develops a
fascination with Gloria (Greta Lee), the group’s charismatic theatrical spirit.
But as he becomes increasingly involved with his new circle, he begins to
question whether they truly admire his work or simply romanticise the idea of
the past they have created around him.
tmdb_overview: Legendary New York poet Ed Saxberger's forgotten works captivate an eccentric group of young creatives, reigniting his artistic passion. Their intrigue intertwines with the bewitching presence of actress Gloria.

as an overlooked literary genius from a bygone era of New York.

Flattered by their attention,
Saxberger is drawn back into the artistic world he left behind and develops a
fascination with Gloria (Greta Lee), the group’s charismatic theatrical spirit.
But as he becomes increasingly involved with his new circle, he begins to
question whether they truly admire his work or simply romanticise the idea of
the past they have created around him.
tmdb_overview: Legendary New York poet Ed Saxberger's forgotten works captivate an eccentric group of young creatives, reigniting his artistic passion. Their intrigue intertwines with the bewitching presence of actress Gloria.

synopsis:
Michael 
Genres: Biography | Drama | Music2025 | USA | 127 mins Director: Antoine FuquaCast: Jaafar Jackson, Juliano Valdi, Colman Domingo, Jayden Harville
Tracing the early life and meteoric
rise of one of the most influential artists of the 20th century, Michael charts
the journey of Michael Jackson from his beginnings as the precociously talented
lead singer of the Jackson 5 to his emergence as a global superstar during the
era of his landmark Bad tour. Portrayed by his nephew Jaafar Jackson,
the film explores the ambition, creativity and pressures that shaped his
ascent. Blending intimate moments with recreations of iconic performances, it
offers a portrait of the artist behind the phenomenon — capturing both the
brilliance and the drive that defined his early career.
Black History Month
screening in conjunction with Croydon Black History Partnership.
tmdb_overview: The story of Michael Jackson, one of the most influential artists the world has ever known, and his life beyond the music. His journey from the discovery of his extraordinary talent as the lead of the Jackson Five, to the visionary artist whose creative ambition fueled a relentless pursuit to become the biggest entertainer in the world, highlighting both his life off-stage and some of the most iconic performances from his early solo career.

synopsis:

Oink + Workshop





“This is Oink. Oink is the best birthday present
I’ve ever had in my life.”

Nine-year-old Babs has always dreamed of having a
pet of her own, so she's overjoyed when her grandfather arrives with a little
piglet for her ninth birthday. She persuades her parents to let her keep the
newly named Oink, and despite some chaotic toilet training, the little pig soon
wins everyone over. But Grandpa's gift isn't quite as innocent as it seems.
He's hiding a secret… and it involves sausages.




Before the film, join us for a
relaxed Eco-Crafternoon celebrating the Harvest Festival. Using an
assortment of recycled materials, we'll create real and imagined farmyard
animals inspired by the film. Each creation will be filmed in time-lapse as it
joins our growing farmyard, building a bustling menagerie of companions for
Oink.

The event finishes
at 2.30pm. 
Presented by Small World Cinema
in association with Croydon Harvest. Tickets £6.

Anyone is welcome to stay behind for a fun chat.Pressure tells the
remarkable untold story behind one of the most important decisions of the
Second World War. In the tense 72 hours before D-Day, Britain’s chief
meteorological officer, Captain James Stagg (Scott), must convince Allied
commanders, including General Eisenhower (Fraser), whether the weather will

history. Gripping, intelligent and led by a stellar cast.

The Cycle of Love 
Genre(s): Documentary/Biography/Action/Adventure/Sci-FiUK/India/Sweden/USA| 2025 | 98 minsDirector: Orlando von EinsiedeStars: PK Mahanandia, Anne-Charlotte von Schedvin, Mina
Dale
In 1975, 23-year-old PK Mahanandia
makes a living drawing portraits for tourists in Delhi when he meets Lotta
(Anne-Charlotte von Schedvin), a Swedish student visiting India. Convinced
their meeting is destiny, PK recalls a childhood prophecy that he would marry a
musical woman from a far-off country, born under the sign of the ox. After
spending time together, Lotta returns to Sweden, promising to come back once
her studies are complete. But when she doesn’t return as planned and PK cannot
afford a plane ticket, he sells everything he owns, buys a second-hand bicycle
and sets off on a 6,000-mile journey across continents to find her.



Based on an extraordinary true
story, The Cycle of Love is a heart-warming tale of love, destiny
and the courage to risk everything for the person you love. Blending
documentary interviews with dramatised scenes, it’s an epic journey that we
challenge you not to shed a tear for!
tmdb_overview: Explores the romantic journey of PK Mahanandia, a Delhi street artist who trekked 6,000 miles by bicycle in 1977, venturing across continents to reunite with the woman he loved.

tmdb_title: Second Nature: Gender and Sexuality in the Animal World
tmdb_original_title: Second Nature: Gender and Sexuality in the Animal World
tmdb_overview: Did you know that clownfish change sex from male to female? (So if Nemo’s mom had died in real life, his dad could have become his mom!) Did you know that albatross, penguins and swans parent in same sex pairs? Or that bonobos, who are just as closely related to us as chimps, are matriarchal and have same-sex sex every day?!  Narrated by Elliot Page, Second Nature follows trailblazing Evolutionary Biologist Dr. Joan Roughgarden as she meets groundbreaking scientists exploring the 1500+ animal species who engage in same-sex sexual behavior and parenting, change sex, form matriarchies, and more,  debunking myths that females are “inferior” and that being queer is “unnatural.”  SECOND NATURE — everything you didn’t learn in high school biology.

synopsis: Drenched in Pedro Almodóvar's signature bright colours, Bitter Christmas is an intriguing, multilayered story about a director who borrows details from his loved ones' lives to flesh out his screenplay – much to their dismay.
tmdb_overview: After her mother dies in December, advertising director Elsa immerses herself in work to cope. The story of these women run parallel to that of a screenwriter and film director, exploring how life and fiction are inseparably linked, sometimes painfully so.

Numb with grief, Evans stops playing.

Drenched in Pedro Almodóvar's signature bright colours, Bitter Christmas is an intriguing, multilayered story about a director who borrows details from his loved ones' lives to flesh out his screenplay – much to their dismay.

When a panic attack forces her to take a break, she decides to travel to Lanzarote with her friend Patricia. The story of these women run parallel to that of a screenwriter and film director, exploring how life and fiction are inseparably linked, sometimes painfully so.

synopsis: In REMAKE, filmmaker Ross McElwee turns his lens on the passage of time and the uneasy space between documenting life and understanding it. tmdb_overview: The death of his son causes McElwee, an autobiographical filmmaker, to look back on his life’s work. He eventually turns to his archive of home movies. Numb with grief, Evans stops playing.

tmdb_overview: Documentarian Ross McElwee originally set out to make a travelogue of sorts tracing General William T. synopsis: Legendary jazz pianist Bill Evans forms his perfect trio, recording two groundbreaking albums. When his brilliant young bassist dies tragically, Evans is devastated. The story follows Evans' journey to overcome grief and return to music.
tmdb_overview: June 1961, NYC: legendary jazz pianist Bill Evans has found his musical voice and created the perfect trio, including bass player Scott LaFaro, said to be his soulmate through music. A residency at New York’s Village Vanguard culminates in the live taping of two of the greatest jazz records of all time in one night. Ten days later, LaFaro dies in a car crash. Numb with grief, Evans stops playing.

synopsis: Drenched in Pedro Almodóvar's signature bright colours, Bitter Christmas is an intriguing, multilayered story about a director who borrows details from his loved ones' lives to flesh out his screenplay – much to their dismay.
tmdb_overview: After her mother dies in December, advertising director Elsa immerses herself in work to cope. When a panic attack forces her to take a break, she decides to travel to Lanzarote with her friend Patricia. The story of these women run parallel to that of a screenwriter and film director, exploring how life and fiction are inseparably linked, sometimes painfully so.

tmdb_overview: June 1961, NYC: legendary jazz pianist Bill Evans has found his musical voice and created the perfect trio, including bass player Scott LaFaro, said to be his soulmate through music. Numb with grief, Evans stops playing.

synopsis: In REMAKE, filmmaker Ross McElwee turns his lens on the passage of time and the uneasy space between documenting life and understanding it. The film traces McElwee’s relationship with his son Adrian, and the fragile bond the camera created between them while Adrian was alive, and now that he’s gone. Drawing from decades of footage, some shot by Ross, some by Adrian, the film becomes a layered excavation of memory and image making. Threaded through is the ghost of another project: a stalled effor
tmdb_overview: The death of his son causes McElwee, an autobiographical filmmaker, to look back on his life’s work. He eventually turns to his archive of home movies. To what extent did his camera affect their relationship when Adrian was alive? To what extent does it define that relationship now that he is gone? Meanwhile, an effort to adapt McElwee’s first feature, Sherman’s March, into a work of fiction lurches along, giving the filmmaker another perspective from which to meditate on movie making and mortality.

synopsis: Drenched in Pedro Almodóvar's signature bright colours, Bitter Christmas is an intriguing, multilayered story about a director who borrows details from his loved ones' lives to flesh out his screenplay – much to their dismay.

tmdb_overview: June 1961, NYC: legendary jazz pianist Bill Evans has found his musical voice and created the perfect trio, including bass player Scott LaFaro, said to be his soulmate through music. tmdb_overview: The death of his son causes McElwee, an autobiographical filmmaker, to look back on his life’s work. He eventually turns to his archive of home movies. synopsis: In REMAKE, filmmaker Ross McElwee turns his lens on the passage of time and the uneasy space between documenting life and understanding it. The film traces McElwee’s relationship with his son Adrian, and the fragile bond the camera created between them while Adrian was alive, and now that he’s gone. Drawing from decades of footage, some shot by Ross, some by Adrian, the film becomes a layered excavation of memory and image making. Threaded through is the ghost of another project: a stalled effor
tmdb_overview: The death of his son causes McElwee, an autobiographical filmmaker, to look back on his life’s work. He eventually turns to his archive of home movies. To what extent did his camera affect their relationship when Adrian was alive? To what extent does it define that relationship now that he is gone? Meanwhile, an effort to adapt McElwee’s first feature, Sherman’s March, into a work of fiction lurches along, giving the filmmaker another perspective from which to meditate on movie making and mortality.

synopsis: Legendary jazz pianist Bill Evans forms his perfect trio, recording two groundbreaking albums. When his brilliant young bassist dies tragically, Evans is devastated. The story follows Evans' journey to overcome grief and return to music.
tmdb_overview: June 1961, NYC: legendary jazz pianist Bill Evans has found his musical voice and created the perfect trio, including bass player Scott LaFaro, said to be his soulmate through music. A residency at New York’s Village Vanguard culminates in the live taping of two of the greatest jazz records of all time in one night. Ten days later, LaFaro dies in a car crash. Numb with grief, Evans stops playing.

tmdb_overview: As a Nairobi journalist probes a land battle entangling the local government and a powerful multinational corporation, covered wounds are revealed and family secrets are exposed.

synopsis: BOORMAN AND THE DEVIL details how Academy Award-nominated director John Boorman took on the massive 1977 sequel Exorcist II: The Heretic, turning down standard horror tropes for a high-budget, metaphysical misfire that became one of Hollywood's most famous box-office disasters.
tmdb_overview: Featuring commentary from surviving participants, as well as other filmmakers and critics, this documentary chronicles the career of director John Boorman and the tumultuous production of his film Exorcist II: The Heretic, exploring its critical and commercial failure, how it changed the industry, and the importance of risk-taking in art.

synopsis: In the heat of a sweltering Indian summer, three generations of women collide in ways that will reshape their lives forever.

Monika is a stressed-out single mom of two teens, calorie-obsessed Alia and rebellious Simi. She decides to send her girls to India to visit their great aunt and uncle. Monika hopes that connecting her daughters to their Punjabi roots will set them straight. But what begins as a reluctant trip soon turns into a transformative coming-of-age journey. Amid culture shock, family clashes, and unexpected bonds, Alia and Simi discover a hidden family tragedy that Monika has kept hidden from them and whose wounds threaten to splinter the entire family in this bittersweet female-driven drama.

synopsis: Gillo Pontecorvo’s riveting film presents a verité portrait of the fight for Algerian independence and the French military’s response.
tmdb_overview: Paratrooper commander Colonel Mathieu, a former French Resistance fighter during World War II, is sent to Algeria to reinforce efforts to squelch the uprisings of the Algerian War. There he faces Ali la Pointe, a former petty criminal who, as the leader of the Algerian Front de Liberation Nationale, directs terror strategies against the colonial French government occupation. As each side resorts to ever-increasing brutality, no violent act is too unthinkable.

synopsis: When a young girl is found murdered in a Breton coastal town, a community begins to devour itself, in this thriller about the social poison that a crime unleashes.
tmdb_overview: In a small Breton town, a 10-year-old girl is found murdered. René, her art teacher, a professional painter, is the last person to have seen her alive. The inspector in charge of the investigation immediately questions him. In this small provincial town where people all know each other and regularly meet at the Bar des Amis, René is increasingly unsettled by the other inhabitants' suspicions and by the inspector's investigation. Children stop coming to him for lessons. His wife, Viviane, a district nurse, protects him and supports him with her love. However, a self-centred media-star writer adds to René's confusion...

After a seven-year hiatus following the devastating loss of their beloved bandmate Chester Bennington, LINKIN PARK'S remaining members struggled to find their way forward. Their shared history and enduring friendship, combined with the fresh perspective of two new band members Emily Armstrong and Colin Brittain spark a renewed creative energy that leads them on a transformative journey of artistic reinvention. Following the band from intimate 2022 studio sessions through their explosive FROM ZERO album release and concert in São Paulo, this documentary weaves together rare vault footage, electrifying performances from sold-out shows, and candid interviews with band members and fans—capturing the raw, honest story of what it means to start over.

tmdb_overview: Ozzy, a friendly, peaceful beagle has his idyllic life turned upside down when the Martins leave on a long and distant trip. There's only one problem: no dogs allowed! Unable to bring their beloved Ozzy along for the ride, they settle on the next best thing, a top-of-the-line canine spa called Blue Creek.

tmdb_title: Royal Opera House: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
tmdb_original_title: Royal Opera House: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
tmdb_overview: A full-length ballet created by choreographer Christopher Wheeldon for the Royal Ballet at the Royal Opera House, Covent Garden. The ballet is based on Lewis Carroll's famous story of Alice, an ordinary girl who one summer afternoon falls down a rabbit hole and finds herself on an extraordinary adventure.  The music is by Joby Talbot, with designs by the internationally acclaimed Bob Crowley. Alice is danced by the Royal Ballet's Lauren Cuthbertson, and actor Simon Russell-Beale plays the cameo role of the Duchess.

synopsis: After the Trojan War, Odysseus (Matt Damon) sets out on a perilous journey home to Ithaca. synopsis: Maria, a primary school teacher doing her best to inspire a class of 10-year-olds, is stifled by one unruly and chaotic student. June, 1940. France collapses and signs the armistice. In the midst of the chaos, one man refuses to give up. Alone against the odds, this unknown general flees to London to save what remains of freedom. Without an army, without backing, without hope. But with one irrational conviction -- France, his France, has not laid down arms. 

Taking the ultimate gamble, he seeks to convince the world that the battle for France is neither over, nor lost. Reality, however, is unyielding and seems determined to prove him wrong. Yet, little by little, resistance fighters, rebellious students and determined soldiers rise up in England, France and Africa to join the cause. Their faith, audacity and thirst for freedom defy what history seemed to have written in advance.

synopsis: Spider-Man: Brand New Day marks an entirely new chapter for Peter Parker and Spider-Man. Four years have passed since the events of No Way Home, and Peter is now an adult living entirely alone, having voluntarily erased himself from the lives and memories of those he loves. Crime-fighting in a New York that no longer knows his name, he’s devoted himself entirely to protecting his city — a full-time Spider-Man — but as the demands on him intensify, the pressure sparks a surprising physical evolution that threatens his existence, even as a strange new pattern of crimes gives rise to one of the most powerful threats he has ever faced.
tmdb_overview: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.

synopsis:
One of the most immersive and rarefied experiences in the history of cinema, Andrei Tarkovsky's Stalker embarks on a metaphysical journey through an enigmatic post-apocalyptic landscape. 

A hired guide- the "Stalker" of the title- leads a writer and a scientist into the heart of the Zone, the restricted site of a long-ago disaster, where the three men eventually zero in on the Room, a place rumoured to fulfil one's most deeply held desires. Adapting a science-fiction novel by Arkady and Boris Strugatsky, and making what would be his final Soviet feature, Tarkovsky created a challenging and visually stunning work, his painstaking attention to material detail and sense of organic atmosphere further enriched by this vivid new digital restoration. 

At once a religious allegory, a reflection of contemporary political anxieties, and a meditation on film itself - among many other interpretations - Stalker envelops the viewer by opening up a multitude of possible meanings.

synopsis:
Start your night right with a complimentary cocktail reception at 6PM. 
In collaboration with Viajante 87.

Everyman is proud to host Steven Soderbergh's A Man Under The Influence.

The series presents one film from each decade selected by Steven Soderbergh as a source of inspiration throughout his career. 

This week it's the 1960's; join us at Everyman at The Whiteley for The Servant (1963) - Hugo Barrett is the servant of the Chelsea home of aristocrat Tony. He appears to be a loyal and competent employee, but Tony’s girlfriend Susan does not like him and asks Tony to send him away. When Barrett persuades Tony to hire his sister Vera as a live-in maid, matters take a turn for the worse.

Each screening is complete with a 63-minute reception featuring Singani 63 cocktails created with some of London's leading bars and inspired by the night's film, alongside a playlist curated by the filmmaker himself, and an exclusive recorded introduction from Soderbergh.

synopsis: Maria, a primary school teacher doing her best to inspire a class of 10-year-olds, is stifled by one unruly and chaotic student. synopsis: In Insidious: Out of the Further, Amelia Eve stars as Gemma, a young mother raising her daughter in the house she grew up in who discovers she can travel into The Further, the purgatorial realm of lost souls at the heart of the Insidious universe. When something evil comes after her, Gemma discovers an ability that changes everything: she doesn’t just enter The Further, she can bring what lives there back to the real world. Once the demons realise her power, our world becomes their playground.

movie_title: Toddler Club: Paw Patrol: The Dino Movie
movie_title_en: Toddler Club: Paw Patrol: The Dino Movie
synopsis:
After their ship gets caught in a mysterious storm, the PAW Patrol pups crash-land on an uncharted tropical island filled with dinosaurs. They meet Rex, a pup who has been stranded on the island for years and has become an expert in all things dino-related. 

When the PAW Patrol's archrival, Mayor Humdinger, begins recklessly mining in hopes of exploiting the island for its natural resources, he inadvertently causes a huge, dormant volcano to erupt. The PAW Patrol pups are thrown into a series of high-stakes, dino-sized rescues bigger than anything they've done before, as they must stop Humdinger before everything on the island goes extinct.

movie_title: Toddler Club: Paw Patrol: The Dino Movie
movie_title_en: Toddler Club: Paw Patrol: The Dino Movie
synopsis:
After their ship gets caught in a mysterious storm, the PAW Patrol pups crash-land on an uncharted tropical island filled with dinosaurs. They meet Rex, a pup who has been stranded on the island for years and has become an expert in all things dino-related. 

When the PAW Patrol's archrival, Mayor Humdinger, begins recklessly mining in hopes of exploiting the island for its natural resources, he inadvertently causes a huge, dormant volcano to erupt. The PAW Patrol pups are thrown into a series of high-stakes, dino-sized rescues bigger than anything they've done before, as they must stop Humdinger before everything on the island goes extinct.

Join us every Friday or Saturday for toddler-friendly cinema screenings. synopsis: Charles De Gaulle's journey as a French army officer from 1940 to 1945, tracking his evolution toward a political career.

Michael Mann returns to Everyman Screen on the Green from 25 September to 24 October. Join us for a season dedicated to five unforgettable works from one of modern cinema's most influential filmmakers.

This week, we're kicking off the season with 'Manhunter', in celebration of its 40th Anniversary. A retired criminal profiler (William Petersen) reluctantly returns to the FBI to help track down a serial killer of families and is forced to consult an expert—the imprisoned Dr. Hannibal Lecktor (Brian Cox in a subtly chilling performance). 

The third feature written and directed by Michael Mann is a gripping adaptation of the first of Thomas Harris's four novels featuring the iconic murderer Lecktor, and benefits from the filmmaker's typically striking visuals as well as a top-notch supporting cast, including Tom Noonan as the hunted killer and three-time Oscar nominee Joan Allen as his blind love interest.
tmdb_overview: FBI Agent Will Graham, retired after catching notorious cannibal Hannibal Lecter, returns to duty to engage in a risky cat-and-mouse game with Lecter to capture a new killer.

movie_title: Toddler Club: Paw Patrol: The Dino Movie
movie_title_en: Toddler Club: Paw Patrol: The Dino Movie
synopsis:
After their ship gets caught in a mysterious storm, the PAW Patrol pups crash-land on an uncharted tropical island filled with dinosaurs. They meet Rex, a pup who has been stranded on the island for years and has become an expert in all things dino-related. 

When the PAW Patrol's archrival, Mayor Humdinger, begins recklessly mining in hopes of exploiting the island for its natural resources, he inadvertently causes a huge, dormant volcano to erupt. The PAW Patrol pups are thrown into a series of high-stakes, dino-sized rescues bigger than anything they've done before, as they must stop Humdinger before everything on the island goes extinct.

Join us every Friday or Saturday for toddler-friendly cinema screenings. tmdb_overview: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. synopsis:
June, 1940. France collapses and signs the armistice. In the midst of the chaos, one man refuses to give up. Alone against the odds, this unknown general flees to London to save what remains of freedom. Without an army, without backing, without hope. But with one irrational conviction -- France, his France, has not laid down arms. 

Taking the ultimate gamble, he seeks to convince the world that the battle for France is neither over, nor lost. Reality, however, is unyielding and seems determined to prove him wrong. Yet, little by little, resistance fighters, rebellious students and determined soldiers rise up in England, France and Africa to join the cause. Their faith, audacity and thirst for freedom defy what history seemed to have written in advance.

Step into the night at Everyman Broadgate with the return of Late Nights. This week, join us for an after-hours screening of Memories of Murder.

In 1986 Gyeonggi Province, South Korea, after two women are found raped and murdered, Seoul detective Seo Tae-yoon is brought in to help local detective Park Doo-man with the investigation. As more bodies are found, the pair realise they have a serial killer on their hands.

Inspired by true events, Bong Joon Ho's sophomore feature blends true-crime with social satire and even comedy is his typically masterful fashion.

movie_title: Relaxed Screening: Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom
movie_title_en: Relaxed Screening: Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom
synopsis:
Welcome to Relaxed Screenings - a comfortable and inclusive way to enjoy the magic of the movies in a sensory and autism-friendly environment. Every month, we host a special screening with reduced volume, dimmed lighting, and no ads or trailers, creating a calm and stress-free setting for neurodiverse guests, including those with autism and sensory sensitivities, and their friends, family, and carers.

Join us Sunday, 27 September, for a relaxed screening of Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom - On Halloween Eve at Mossy Bottom Farm, excitement turns to dismay when the clumsy Farmer ruins the pumpkin patch. Shaun tries fixing it with science experiments, but things go wrong when a wild beast appears in the woods.

BBFC Content Warning - Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom is rated U, with very mild threat, scary scenes, rude humour, implied bad language. Check the BBFC website for further information: https://www.bbfc.co.uk/release/shaun-the-sheep-the-beast-of-mossy-bottom-q29sbgvjdglvbjpwwc0xmdmxmtuz

movie_title: Toddler Club: Paw Patrol: The Dino Movie
movie_title_en: Toddler Club: Paw Patrol: The Dino Movie
synopsis:
After their ship gets caught in a mysterious storm, the PAW Patrol pups crash-land on an uncharted tropical island filled with dinosaurs. They meet Rex, a pup who has been stranded on the island for years and has become an expert in all things dino-related. 

When the PAW Patrol's archrival, Mayor Humdinger, begins recklessly mining in hopes of exploiting the island for its natural resources, he inadvertently causes a huge, dormant volcano to erupt. The PAW Patrol pups are thrown into a series of high-stakes, dino-sized rescues bigger than anything they've done before, as they must stop Humdinger before everything on the island goes extinct.

Join us every Friday or Saturday for toddler-friendly cinema screenings. From ages 1 to 5, share your childhood favourites and the best new family film releases with your pre-schoolers, and we’ll bring you a warm drink and a slice of cake or a small popcorn, all included in the price of your ticket.

Maria, a primary school teacher doing her best to inspire a class of 10-year-olds, is stifled by one unruly and chaotic student. With her career in question and the child's behaviour spiralling, she makes a series of bad decisions that lead to her accidentally taking and locking this "bad apple" in her home. Maria tries desperately to backtrack, but when the class starts flourishing and the staff and parents are thrilled with the improvement, she finds herself in a very complicated predicament.

synopsis: Spider-Man: Brand New Day marks an entirely new chapter for Peter Parker and Spider-Man. Four years have passed since the events of No Way Home, and Peter is now an adult living entirely alone, having voluntarily erased himself from the lives and memories of those he loves. Crime-fighting in a New York that no longer knows his name, he’s devoted himself entirely to protecting his city — a full-time Spider-Man — but as the demands on him intensify, the pressure sparks a surprising physical evolution that threatens his existence, even as a strange new pattern of crimes gives rise to one of the most powerful threats he has ever faced.
tmdb_overview: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.

synopsis:

But ACME has its own powerhouse defence attorney in Kevin’s slick nemesis Buddy Crane (John Cena), who is determined to silence Wile E. and Kevin.

Wile E. and Kevin embark on a wild quest for justice that’s as thrilling and physics-defying as Wile E.’s lifelong chase for the ever-speedy Road Runner.

synopsis:
June, 1940. France collapses and signs the armistice. In the midst of the chaos, one man refuses to give up. Alone against the odds, this unknown general flees to London to save what remains of freedom. Without an army, without backing, without hope. But with one irrational conviction -- France, his France, has not laid down arms. 

Taking the ultimate gamble, he seeks to convince the world that the battle for France is neither over, nor lost. Reality, however, is unyielding and seems determined to prove him wrong. Yet, little by little, resistance fighters, rebellious students and determined soldiers rise up in England, France and Africa to join the cause. Their faith, audacity and thirst for freedom defy what history seemed to have written in advance.

synopsis:
Academy Award® nominee Monica Barbaro (A Complete Unknown, Top Gun: Maverick) and BAFTA nominee Callum Turner (Masters of the Air, Fantastic Beasts franchise) star as Allie and Owen, two love-starved strangers who crash into each other in an ever-so-slightly fictionalized New York City on the one night of the year when single people are allowed to have sex.

Recently dumped Owen and hopeful romantic Allie might be the only two singles in the city looking for more than just a quick encounter. They both feel a spark when they meet, but a series of missteps and side quests complicate their night, keeping them apart. As they each race toward and away from each other across the city, they just might discover that the one thing they want most is closer than they think.

synopsis:
Michael Mann returns to Everyman Screen on the Green from 25 September to 24 October. Join us for a season dedicated to five unforgettable works from one of modern cinema's most influential filmmakers.

This week, we're kicking off the season with 'Manhunter', in celebration of its 40th Anniversary. A retired criminal profiler (William Petersen) reluctantly returns to the FBI to help track down a serial killer of families and is forced to consult an expert—the imprisoned Dr. Hannibal Lecktor (Brian Cox in a subtly chilling performance). 

The third feature written and directed by Michael Mann is a gripping adaptation of the first of Thomas Harris's four novels featuring the iconic murderer Lecktor, and benefits from the filmmaker's typically striking visuals as well as a top-notch supporting cast, including Tom Noonan as the hunted killer and three-time Oscar nominee Joan Allen as his blind love interest.
tmdb_overview: FBI Agent Will Graham, retired after catching notorious cannibal Hannibal Lecter, returns to duty to engage in a risky cat-and-mouse game with Lecter to capture a new killer.

synopsis:
June, 1940. France collapses and signs the armistice. In the midst of the chaos, one man refuses to give up. Alone against the odds, this unknown general flees to London to save what remains of freedom. Without an army, without backing, without hope. But with one irrational conviction -- France, his France, has not laid down arms. 

Taking the ultimate gamble, he seeks to convince the world that the battle for France is neither over, nor lost. Reality, however, is unyielding and seems determined to prove him wrong. Yet, little by little, resistance fighters, rebellious students and determined soldiers rise up in England, France and Africa to join the cause. Their faith, audacity and thirst for freedom defy what history seemed to have written in advance.

synopsis:
The epic conclusion to the Infinity Saga returns to Everyman as Avengers: Endgame (Encore) on September 25, 2026.

synopsis: Maria, a primary school teacher doing her best to inspire a class of 10-year-olds, is stifled by one unruly and chaotic student. With her career in question and the child's behaviour spiralling, she makes a series of bad decisions that lead to her accidentally taking and locking this "bad apple" in her home. Maria tries desperately to backtrack, but when the class starts flourishing and the staff and parents are thrilled with the improvement, she finds herself in a very complicated predicament.

synopsis:
A retired criminal profiler (William Petersen) reluctantly returns to the FBI to help track down a serial killer of families and is forced to consult an expert—the imprisoned Dr. Hannibal Lecktor (Brian Cox in a subtly chilling performance). The third feature written and directed by Michael Mann is a gripping adaptation of the first of Thomas Harris's four novels featuring the iconic murderer Lecktor, and benefits from the filmmaker's typically striking visuals as well as a top-notch supporting cast, including Tom Noonan as the hunted killer and three-time Oscar nominee Joan Allen as his blind love interest.

Screening on Sundays and Wednesdays as part of our Throwback Season, where we revisit classics. Each ticket to these showtimes includes complimentary popcorn and a drink.

A retired criminal profiler (William Petersen) reluctantly returns to the FBI to help track down a serial killer of families and is forced to consult an expert—the imprisoned Dr. Hannibal Lecktor (Brian Cox in a subtly chilling performance). synopsis:
June, 1940. France collapses and signs the armistice. In the midst of the chaos, one man refuses to give up. Alone against the odds, this unknown general flees to London to save what remains of freedom. Without an army, without backing, without hope. But with one irrational conviction -- France, his France, has not laid down arms. 

Taking the ultimate gamble, he seeks to convince the world that the battle for France is neither over, nor lost. Reality, however, is unyielding and seems determined to prove him wrong. Yet, little by little, resistance fighters, rebellious students and determined soldiers rise up in England, France and Africa to join the cause. Their faith, audacity and thirst for freedom defy what history seemed to have written in advance.

synopsis:
Michael Mann returns to Everyman Screen on the Green from 25 September to 24 October. Join us for a season dedicated to five unforgettable works from one of modern cinema's most influential filmmakers.

This week, we're kicking off the season with 'Manhunter', in celebration of its 40th Anniversary. A retired criminal profiler (William Petersen) reluctantly returns to the FBI to help track down a serial killer of families and is forced to consult an expert—the imprisoned Dr. Hannibal Lecktor (Brian Cox in a subtly chilling performance). 

The third feature written and directed by Michael Mann is a gripping adaptation of the first of Thomas Harris's four novels featuring the iconic murderer Lecktor, and benefits from the filmmaker's typically striking visuals as well as a top-notch supporting cast, including Tom Noonan as the hunted killer and three-time Oscar nominee Joan Allen as his blind love interest.

movie_title: L’Oréal Paris: ‘Le Défilé’ Live from Paris Fashion Week
movie_title_en: L’Oréal Paris: ‘Le Défilé’ Live from Paris Fashion Week
synopsis:
AS OFFICIAL PARTNER OF THE PARIS FASHION WEEK, L’ORÉAL PARIS WILL HOST ITS ANNUAL PUBLIC RUNWAY SHOW IN FRONT OF THE EIFFEL TOWER, IN CELEBRATION OF WOMEN’S EMPOWERMENT.

On September 28th at 9pm EST (8pm BST), Place Joffre will transform into an open-air stage where beauty, fashion and self-expression come together. Set between the Eiffel Tower and the École Militaire, L'Oréal Paris' iconic public runway show invites women to Express Their Worth, celebrating women’s empowerment, inclusivity, freedom, confidence and sisterhood.

For the ninth time since 2017, Le Défilé L’Oréal Paris will celebrate sisterhood and the synergy between state-of-the-art beauty expertise and fashion, featuring global make-up artist Harold James and hair expert Stéphane Lancien.

Exclusive Everyman Screening Perks
- Welcome drink upon arrival
- 60-minute, pre-show cocktail reception from 7pm
- A special surprise musical guest during the event
- An exclusive money-can't-buy goodie bag featuring L'Oréal Paris products (worth over £75)

Featuring a Star-Studded Catwalk Line-Up with; Simone Ashley, Marie Bochet, Viola Davis, Cara Delevingne, Jane Fonda, Bebe Vio Grandis, Ariana Greenblatt, Luma Grothe, Kendall Jenner, Aja Naomi King, Eva Longoria, Andie MacDowell, Aishwarya Rai, and newly appointed ambassador Kristen Bell.

movie_title: Odyssey 2026 Opening Film: Because of You Ka Kui
movie_title_en: Odyssey 2026 Opening Film: Because of You Ka Kui
synopsis:
Join us at Everyman King's Cross on Monday, 28 September, for the Opening Night of the Odyssey Film Festival 2026 and the UK Premiere of Because of You Ka Kui.

Arrive from 6pm to enjoy a 60-minute pre-film reception with food and drinks, then stay after the screening for a special Q&A with director Rosa Pang and producer Leslie Chan.

Wong Ka Kui remains one of the most recognisable and beloved figures in Hong Kong popular culture, who fronted the most iconic rock band from the city, Beyond. But behind the music, the image and the legend, who was the person his friends and companions actually knew? 

Directed by Rosa Pang and produced by Beyond founding member Yip Sai Wing and the band’s former manager Leslie Chan, this documentary moves beyond the celebrity and rediscover the person through intimate memories from those who knew him closely - his music, personality, ideals and aspirations.

As the Opening Film for annual festival Odyssey 2026 , "Because of You Ka Kui" provides a meaningful starting point for this year’s theme, #Fashion. From 28 September to 10 October, Odyssey explores fashion beyond what we wear via an eclectic programme; as identity, attitude, culture, memory and the way a generation expresses itself.

In this spirit, Ka Kui’s enduring influence reminds us that fashion is also about how a generation chooses to look, sound and live.

Supported by the Hong Kong Economic Trade Office in London.

synopsis:
Award-winner Sandra Oh (Killing Eve) plays the title role in this razor-sharp reimagining of Molière’s classic dark comedy.
 
Telling the truth isn’t always that simple. Alice, a brilliant novelist, despises the carefully constructed lies of modern society. But the more she challenges those around her, the fiercer the backlash becomes. Soon, she must confront the price of speaking her truth in a world that would rather silence her. 
 
Filmed live on stage at the National Theatre, Indhu Rubasingham directs Martin Crimp’s (Cyrano de Bergerac) highly anticipated play.

synopsis: Maria, a primary school teacher doing her best to inspire a class of 10-year-olds, is stifled by one unruly and chaotic student. With her career in question and the child's behaviour spiralling, she makes a series of bad decisions that lead to her accidentally taking and locking this "bad apple" in her home. Maria tries desperately to backtrack, but when the class starts flourishing and the staff and parents are thrilled with the improvement, she finds herself in a very complicated predicament.

synopsis:
June, 1940. France collapses and signs the armistice. In the midst of the chaos, one man refuses to give up. Alone against the odds, this unknown general flees to London to save what remains of freedom. Without an army, without backing, without hope. But with one irrational conviction -- France, his France, has not laid down arms. 

Taking the ultimate gamble, he seeks to convince the world that the battle for France is neither over, nor lost. Reality, however, is unyielding and seems determined to prove him wrong. Yet, little by little, resistance fighters, rebellious students and determined soldiers rise up in England, France and Africa to join the cause. Their faith, audacity and thirst for freedom defy what history seemed to have written in advance.

synopsis: Spider-Man: Brand New Day marks an entirely new chapter for Peter Parker and Spider-Man. Four years have passed since the events of No Way Home, and Peter is now an adult living entirely alone, having voluntarily erased himself from the lives and memories of those he loves. Crime-fighting in a New York that no longer knows his name, he’s devoted himself entirely to protecting his city — a full-time Spider-Man — but as the demands on him intensify, the pressure sparks a surprising physical evolution that threatens his existence, even as a strange new pattern of crimes gives rise to one of the most powerful threats he has ever faced.
tmdb_overview: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.

synopsis:
A retired criminal profiler (William Petersen) reluctantly returns to the FBI to help track down a serial killer of families and is forced to consult an expert—the imprisoned Dr. Hannibal Lecktor (Brian Cox in a subtly chilling performance). synopsis:
June, 1940. France collapses and signs the armistice. In the midst of the chaos, one man refuses to give up. Alone against the odds, this unknown general flees to London to save what remains of freedom. Without an army, without backing, without hope. But with one irrational conviction -- France, his France, has not laid down arms. 

Taking the ultimate gamble, he seeks to convince the world that the battle for France is neither over, nor lost. Reality, however, is unyielding and seems determined to prove him wrong. Yet, little by little, resistance fighters, rebellious students and determined soldiers rise up in England, France and Africa to join the cause. Their faith, audacity and thirst for freedom defy what history seemed to have written in advance.

movie_title: Knife: The Attempted Murder of Salman Rushdie + Recorded Q&A
movie_title_en: Knife: The Attempted Murder of Salman Rushdie + Recorded Q&A
synopsis:
Join us on Wednesday, 30 September, for a special screening of Knife: The Attempted Murder of Salam Rushdie followed by a recorded Q&A, only at select Everyman venues.

Gibney’s “Knife” will explore Rushdie’s recovery “in the broadest sense”, according to a press release. Through Rushdie’s wife Rachel Eliza Griffiths’ personal footage, which has never been seen by the public, the doctor will follow the writer during not only his physical recovery but also the recovery of his spirit and hope for the future. In "Knife", Rushdie writes, “It’s a story in which hatred—the knife as a metaphor of hate—is answered and finally overcome by love.”
tmdb_title: Knife: The Attempted Murder of Salman Rushdie
tmdb_original_title: Knife: The Attempted Murder of Salman Rushdie
tmdb_overview: In 2022, Salman Rushdie was preparing to deliver a lecture on the United States as a safe haven for writers when a man rushed the stage and, in 27 seconds, stabbed him 15 times. Airlifted to hospital, Rushdie survived, barely, and his wife Rachel Eliza Griffiths began filming immediately, capturing an unfiltered view of his recovery, return to life and how he regained his spirit and hope for the future.

synopsis:
The hardest part of moving on is starting over.

After a seven-year hiatus following the devastating loss of their beloved bandmate, Chester Bennington, LINKIN PARK's remaining members struggle to find a path forward. Their shared history and enduring friendship, combined with the fresh perspective brought by two new band members, spark a renewed creative energy that sets them on a transformative journey of artistic reinvention.

Following the band from intimate studio sessions in 2022 through the release of their FROM ZERO album and their explosive concert in São Paulo, UNSHATTER weaves together rare archival footage, electrifying performances from sold-out shows, and candid interviews with band members and fans. The film captures the raw, honest story of what it means to begin again.
tmdb_overview: After a seven-year hiatus following the devastating loss of their beloved bandmate Chester Bennington, LINKIN PARK'S remaining members struggled to find their way forward. Their shared history and enduring friendship, combined with the fresh perspective of two new band members Emily Armstrong and Colin Brittain spark a renewed creative energy that leads them on a transformative journey of artistic reinvention. Following the band from intimate 2022 studio sessions through their explosive FROM ZERO album release and concert in São Paulo, this documentary weaves together rare vault footage, electrifying performances from sold-out shows, and candid interviews with band members and fans—capturing the raw, honest story of what it means to start over.

synopsis:
A retired criminal profiler (William Petersen) reluctantly returns to the FBI to help track down a serial killer of families and is forced to consult an expert—the imprisoned Dr. Hannibal Lecktor (Brian Cox in a subtly chilling performance). The third feature written and directed by Michael Mann is a gripping adaptation of the first of Thomas Harris's four novels featuring the iconic murderer Lecktor, and benefits from the filmmaker's typically striking visuals as well as a top-notch supporting cast, including Tom Noonan as the hunted killer and three-time Oscar nominee Joan Allen as his blind love interest.

synopsis:
The hardest part of moving on is starting over.

After a seven-year hiatus following the devastating loss of their beloved bandmate, Chester Bennington, LINKIN PARK's remaining members struggle to find a path forward. Their shared history and enduring friendship, combined with the fresh perspective brought by two new band members, spark a renewed creative energy that sets them on a transformative journey of artistic reinvention.

Following the band from intimate studio sessions in 2022 through the release of their FROM ZERO album and their explosive concert in São Paulo, UNSHATTER weaves together rare archival footage, electrifying performances from sold-out shows, and candid interviews with band members and fans. The film captures the raw, honest story of what it means to begin again.
tmdb_overview: After a seven-year hiatus following the devastating loss of their beloved bandmate Chester Bennington, LINKIN PARK'S remaining members struggled to find their way forward. Their shared history and enduring friendship, combined with the fresh perspective of two new band members Emily Armstrong and Colin Brittain spark a renewed creative energy that leads them on a transformative journey of artistic reinvention. Following the band from intimate 2022 studio sessions through their explosive FROM ZERO album release and concert in São Paulo, this documentary weaves together rare vault footage, electrifying performances from sold-out shows, and candid interviews with band members and fans—capturing the raw, honest story of what it means to start over.

synopsis:
June, 1940. France collapses and signs the armistice. In the midst of the chaos, one man refuses to give up. Alone against the odds, this unknown general flees to London to save what remains of freedom. Without an army, without backing, without hope. But with one irrational conviction -- France, his France, has not laid down arms. 

Taking the ultimate gamble, he seeks to convince the world that the battle for France is neither over, nor lost. Reality, however, is unyielding and seems determined to prove him wrong. Yet, little by little, resistance fighters, rebellious students and determined soldiers rise up in England, France and Africa to join the cause. Their faith, audacity and thirst for freedom defy what history seemed to have written in advance.

movie_title: Odyssey 2026: KJ: Music and Life (UK Premiere)
movie_title_en: Odyssey 2026: KJ: Music and Life (UK Premiere)
synopsis:
KJ: Music and Life is a portrait of a Hong Kong musical genius. At just 11 years old, KJ won the Best Pianist prize and travelled to the Czech Republic to perform with a professional orchestra. Touching on questions of life, God and the artistic process, the director’s six years of conversations with KJ reveal a young man deeply inspired by his music teacher, Nancy Loo, while often finding himself in conflict with his peers and parents. Yet KJ is ultimately not a film about the triumph of a genius, but about something much more fundamental: how a gifted young man learns what it means to be a “human being”.

The Best Documentary, Best Film Editing and Best Sound Effects at the 46th Golden Horse Awards - this is the first appearance of this hidden gem in the UK. 

Part of Odyssey, a film festival (28 Sep - 10 Oct). 2026 theme:  #fashion.
Partially in Cantonese with English subtitles.

The series presents one film from each decade selected by Steven Soderbergh as a source of inspiration throughout his career.
